issues: Operator did not complete the mandatory health check-in: sleep question and medication adherence were never asked.
Operator did not ask the mood check-in question explicitly as required by the skill; instead, the senior's mood was inferred from his complaints.
Operator missed the opportunity to gently steer the conversation back to the wellness check-in purpose after acknowledging the senior's distress.
Operator did not address the senior by name in the first turn, missing a warmth and rapport opportunity.
Operator failed to follow up on the senior's mention of his granddaughter Basia, missing a chance to build trust.
Operator repeatedly returned to the same question without fully addressing the senior's distrust, violating active listening principles.
Farewell was generic and did not reference any specific detail from the call, as required by the farewell skill.
After senior said 'Dobrze' to the sleep question, operator skipped the required probe 'Co sprawia, że czuje się Pan dzisiaj dobrze?' and instead responded with 'Miło to słyszeć.'
Operator did not ask the mandatory sleep question as a standalone turn; it was embedded in the conversation.
No probe was made after the initial mood question 'Jak się pan dzisiaj czuje?' — senior said 'Dzień dobry' (non-answer) but operator did not clarify the mood.
Operator did not use the senior's name at any point after the first turn, which reduces personal warmth.
